nodes.name: Schedule Trigger (9 AM Daily)
nodes.notes: Triggers the full Vistaar analysis pipeline every morning at 9:00 AM automatically. To test manually, click 'Test Workflow' in n8n.

nodes.name: Get Merchant Alerts Data
nodes.notes: Fetches signals, summary, merchant profile and inventory from Vistaar backend. This is the single source of truth for the workflow.

parameters.url: =http://localhost:8000/cognee/search?q={{ encodeURIComponent($json.signals && $json.signals[0] ? $json.signals[0].category + ' demand pattern history' : 'merchant normal sales pattern') }}

nodes.name: Retrieve Cognee Memory
nodes.notes: Searches Cognee for merchant memories relevant to the top signal. Returns historical context that enriches AI reasoning. Empty results are safe — system continues without Cognee.

nodes.name: Run AI Reasoning Pipeline
nodes.notes: Triggers the full pipeline: decision engine + Cognee context + Gemini AI reasoning. Returns a complete notification with priority, recommendation, and full explainability.

nodes.name: Alert Required?
nodes.notes: Checks if the AI + decision engine determined an alert is needed. YES branch → post alert + notify. NO branch → stop (no action needed).

parameters.jsonBody:
={
  "source": "n8n",
  "workflow_id": "vistaar-daily-check",
  "priority": "{{ $('Run AI Reasoning Pipeline').item.json.priority }}",
  "has_alert": {{ $('Run AI Reasoning Pipeline').item.json.has_alert }},
  "recommendation": "{{ $('Run AI Reasoning Pipeline').item.json.recommendation }}",
  "explanation": "{{ $('Run AI Reasoning Pipeline').item.json.explanation }}",
  "what_happened": "{{ $('Run AI Reasoning Pipeline').item.json.what_happened }}",
  "why_it_matters": "{{ $('Run AI Reasoning Pipeline').item.json.why_it_matters }}",
  "evidence": "{{ $('Run AI Reasoning Pipeline').item.json.evidence }}",
  "what_next": "{{ $('Run AI Reasoning Pipeline').item.json.what_next }}",
  "historical_context": "{{ $('Run AI Reasoning Pipeline').item.json.historical_context }}",
  "signals": {{ JSON.stringify($('Run AI Reasoning Pipeline').item.json.signals || []) }}
}

nodes.name: Post Alert to Dashboard
nodes.notes: Posts the completed alert to the Vistaar backend. This saves it to notifications.json and makes it appear in the History tab instantly.

nodes.name: Send Webhook Notification (Demo)
nodes.notes: Sends a demo notification to a webhook URL. For the demo: set N8N_WEBHOOK_URL env var in n8n to a webhook.site URL. This step is optional — continueOnFail=true means the workflow won't break if this fails.

string.name: status
string.value: No action needed — all metrics within normal range.

nodes.name: No Action Needed
nodes.notes: NO branch: All metrics are within the merchant's normal range. Workflow stops here — no alert generated.
